user.title: Add a TV running Luma
user.description: On the TV, open Luma → Settings → System → Home Assistant and turn it on. Luma shows the address to enter here.

discovery_confirm.title: Luma found
discovery_confirm.description: Pair Home Assistant with Luma on {name}?

pair.title: Enter the code on the TV
pair.description: Luma on {name} is showing a six-digit pairing code.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: Luma on {name} no longer knows this Home Assistant server, for example because Home Assistant was turned off in Luma. Make sure it is on, then continue to get a new code.

error.cannot_connect: Luma did not answer. Check that the TV is on, Luma is running and Home Assistant is turned on in Luma's settings.
error.invalid_code: That code is not the one shown on the TV.
error.pairing_expired: The code expired or too many wrong codes were entered. Submit again for a new code.
error.too_soon: Wait a few seconds, then submit again for a new code.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.
abort.not_luma: This TV is not running Luma with Home Assistant turned on.
abort.pairing_refused: Luma refused pairing. Turn Home Assistant off and on in Luma, then try again.

phone_keyboard.title: Type on your phone
phone_keyboard.description: When a text field opens on the TV, such as search, these phones get a notification. Reply to it to type into the TV instead of using the remote. Phones need the Home Assistant app.

data_description.keyboard_phones: None chosen turns this off. Phones only appear here once the Home Assistant app is signed in on them.

streaming_keys.title: Streaming search keys
streaming_keys.description:
Luma's search uses Movie of the Night to find where a show streams and TMDB to rank results. Keys are checked when you submit, then kept in sync with the TV.

Leave a field empty to keep the key already on the TV.

data_description.motn_api_key: Get one at [Movie of the Night]({motn_url}). It starts with `motn-key-`. A RapidAPI Streaming Availability key also works.
data_description.tmdb_read_access_token: The long **API Read Access Token** in your [TMDB API settings]({tmdb_url}), not the short API key.

error.motn_refused: Movie of the Night refused this key. Check it is complete and the subscription is active.
error.tmdb_refused: TMDB refused this token. Use the API Read Access Token, not the API key.

show_camera.name: Show camera
show_camera.description: Shows a camera in a corner of the TV over whatever is playing.

config_entry_id.name: TV
config_entry_id.description: The TV to show it on. Leave empty for every TV.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: A camera entity, such as a UniFi Protect doorbell.

stream_url.name: Stream URL
stream_url.description: A motion-JPEG URL the TV can load directly, such as go2rtc's stream.mjpeg. Overrides the camera's stream.

snapshot_url.name: Snapshot URL
snapshot_url.description: A JPEG URL the TV reloads every refresh interval. Overrides the camera's snapshot.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Live video (the default) plays a camera entity's HLS stream at its full frame rate (shows motion-JPEG until it plays, or if it cannot). Live motion-JPEG falls back to snapshots. Or snapshots only.

refresh.name: Snapshot interval
refresh.description: Seconds between snapshots in snapshot mode or fallback.

message.name: Message
message.description: A second line under the title.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds before the overlay closes. BACK on the remote closes it sooner.

pause.name: Pause playback
pause.description: Pause what is playing while the overlay shows and resume afterwards. Live TV may keep playing.

base_url.name: Home Assistant URL
base_url.description: How the TV reaches Home Assistant for camera images. Defaults to Home Assistant's local network URL.

dismiss.name: Dismiss overlay
dismiss.description: Closes the camera overlay and resumes paused playback.

config_entry_id.name: TV
config_entry_id.description: The TV to close it on. Leave empty for every TV.

notify.name: Show toast
notify.description: Shows a short webOS notification over whatever is playing.

config_entry_id.name: TV
config_entry_id.description: The TV to show it on. Leave empty for every TV.
